chapter: Georgie Auld, Hawkins and Los Angeles
title: Johnny Hartsfield in Denver
summary: He recalls tenor player Johnny Hartsfield, a buddy in Denver who showed him things.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Yeah, I think Taps Miller or something like that. But I really didn't remember the date. But there's a whole lot of things I guess I don't remember. I forgot to mention that I knew Johnny Hartsfield out in Denver. Do you know Johnny?
I've seen pictures of him playing on 52nd Street. Tenor player.
Yeah. He was a good tenor player.
When did you know him in Denver?
When I went out there to play with Art Bronson, you know, with the Bostonians.
Yeah, you did mention that. He was from that area?
Well, I met him in Denver, you see. We got

to be buddies in Denver, because we'd go out to play together. You know, when there was nothing else happening, we'd just get our horns and go play somewhere, you know -- if there was anybody playing anywhere. So I forgot to mention that he was a very good friend of mine. And he hipped me to a lot of stuff that I didn't know about. Which I appreciated, because when you're green, you're green; you just don't know, you know...
Did you know him again when he was in New York?
Yeah, I saw him here in New York. But I haven't seen him lately, and I didn't see him the last time I was out in Denver, so I don't know where he is.
When he was in New York, what kind of a style was he playing in?

Well, he played like Johnny. I think... That's the only thing I can see. And I really don't remember how he played anyway, as far as the style is concerned, but I liked what he was playing when I met him. I imagine I liked him when I heard him the last time he was here in New York. I don't remember where that was, but...
As I said, I've seen pictures of him playing with some bands in one of the 52nd Street clubs.
Yeah. Well, maybe he did play down there.
Oh yeah? Well, good. Maybe he did play with Joe Guy. Joe was a good guy anyway.
